metadata.description: Update a specific item within a price book in your HubSpot account.
metadata.learn_more: Update a specific item within a price book in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to modify details such as pricing, billing frequency, and custom properties for the specified item. Ensure that the item is identified correctly by its unique priceBookId and priceBookItemId.

priceBookId.label: Price Book Id
priceBookId.description: The unique identifier of the price book containing the item to update.

priceBookItemId.label: Price Book Item Id
priceBookItemId.description: The unique identifier of the item within the price book to update.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: A boolean indicating whether the price book item is archived.

billingFrequency.label: Billing Frequency
billingFrequency.description: An object specifying the frequency at which billing occurs for the price book item.

billingPeriod.label: Billing Period
billingPeriod.description: An object specifying the period over which billing occurs for the price book item.

customProperties.label: Custom Properties
customProperties.description: A map of custom property names to their values, allowing for additional customization of the price book item.

prices.label: Prices
prices.description: An array of PriceUpdateEntry objects, each representing the pricing details for a product, including the currency code and amount.

status.label: Status
status.description: An object indicating the current status of the price book item.
